newsitem.title: USA: Harleysville sees Q3 losses of $0.61/shr.
newsitem.headline: Harleysville sees Q3 losses of $0.61/shr.

text.p: Harleysville Group Inc said Monday it estimates losses from Hurricane Fran to reduce earnings for the third quarter by $7.4 million, or about $0.53 per share, after pooling and taxes.

Losses from Hurricane Bertha will reduce the quarter's earnings by about $1.1 million, or $0.08 per share after pooling and taxes, bringing total third quarter hurricane losses to $8.5 million, or $0.61 per share, Harleysville said.

The insurance industry's total insured losses from Hurricane Fran have been estimated at $1.6 billion, making Fran the fourth largest insured hurricane loss ever in the U.S., the company said in a released statement.
Harleysville said it plans to report third quarter earnings on October 24.
